title: MBK's useful items
description: Utility gadgets and wearable tools for Fabric 1.21.10.
body:
MBK’s Useful Items is a Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.10 focused on immersive utility gadgets, exploration tools, and quality-of-life equipment. The mod adds a growing collection of unique wearable gear and handheld devices designed to make survival gameplay more fun, convenient, and adventurous without completely changing vanilla balance.

Current and planned features include wearable Night Vision Goggles, Loot Magnets, Portable Crafting Tablets, Grappling Hooks, Ore Scanners, Builder Wands, Recall Beacons, Treasure Goggles, Portable Camp Kits, Dungeon Recovery Kits, and more.

The mod uses a lightly steampunk-inspired aesthetic with magical tech elements powered by redstone, copper, amethyst, and other vanilla materials. Every item is designed to feel like a believable survival gadget that fits naturally into Minecraft progression.

Features:

* Utility-focused gameplay additions
* Wearable gadgets and advanced tools
* Exploration and dungeon support items
* Survival-friendly balancing
* Vanilla-style crafting integration
* Fabric 1.21.10 support
* Lightweight and modular design

MBK’s Useful Items aims to expand Minecraft’s survival experience with practical tools that feel rewarding to craft and satisfying to use.
